title: OOC
body:
Syntax: ooc <message>

Description: Sends a message on the server-wide out-of-character channel -- everyone online sees it, regardless of room or village.

The last 25 OOC messages are saved -- see 'help chatlog' to review them.

Filtered words are automatically censored. Sending too many messages too quickly (say/ooc/village chat combined) triggers an automatic 10-minute silence -- see 'help silence'.

Date: 2026-08-26
